stage: S1 / M1 controller-recoverability study (development data only; never confirmatory). Decides gate G1.

questions.H1: Is the 15-D controller representation adequate, with budget/search the bottleneck? (ctrl15 budget curve to 8k)
questions.H3: Does SIMBICON-style foot-placement feedback (17-D, phasegait_fp; zero gains = the 15-D controller) make more bodies walkable at equal budget? (ctrl17 vs ctrl15, joint17 vs joint15)
questions.H4: Does joint body+controller search recover more than controller-only at equal budget? (joint vs ctrl)
questions.H5: Which dev creatures remain unrecovered at 8k under any representation (reported as 'not recovered within 8k', never 'impossible')
questions.H7: Does training on 3 nominal seeds (the old protocol) generalise worse than 8 seeds under the validation-variation preset? (h7 vs ctrl15 at the 4k checkpoint)

design_decisions_from_m1a: joint search starts from the R2 transfer (not the similarity transfer, which never helped in M1a)
budget 8k with checkpoints 1k/2k/4k/8k (M1a searches were still improving at 4k)
panel_rule: creature_gen.generate_panel: guided bodies from GEN_DIST, region cap, min distance 0.15, accepted iff the R2-transfer walk challenge on 8 selection seeds is aggregate FAIL with <= 1 walking seed; every draw recorded; the panel file is written once before any unit and its sha256 is stored in every result line
optimizer: walk_opt.cma_search defaults (sigma0 0.2 in [0,1] units, IPOP restarts, Hansen 2016 parameters); 17-D searches start with foot-placement gains 0 (= the 15-D start point)
recovery_rule: recovery.full_recovery_v1 (unchanged from M1a); verdict_v1 and WalkingCriteria unchanged
body_edit_rules: joint search inside the edit-rule ratio box [0.5, 1.5] and the guided bounds; 4 body parameters

analysis.primary_descriptive: per creature x condition: status at the final checkpoint (replicate 1 and 2 shown separately; a creature counts as 'recovered by condition X' if ANY replicate of X is FULL_RECOVERY, and the replicate agreement is reported)
analysis.gate_G1: dev full-recovery fraction = creatures (of 12) fully recovered at 8k by the best condition; >= 50% proceed; 25-50% mixed response (plan section H); < 25% controller research
analysis.secondary: budget curves (checkpoint status), walking fractions, ctrl17-ctrl15 and joint-ctrl paired per creature (descriptive counts, no test), H7 at 4k, train-vs-validation gap, gait features of recovered vs unrecovered
analysis.no_tests: development study: counts and paired tables only; nothing here is used as confirmatory evidence

execution: temporary cpu-d3 64vcpu VM (owner-approved 2026-10-16), 12 shards (one creature each) x 3 workers, each shard its own append-only file; deterministic units
wording_rule: an unrecovered creature is 'not recovered within budget X under representation Y', never 'impossible'
